when: the firmware posts event type 6 (inferred: its park / power-off request)
slave-port accesses (in order): poll MSLVCTRL1 for READY or GBLPORT_IDLE (mask 0x05000000, about 100 ms); CTRL0 = 0x04800000 (T0 TXENABLE), DATAT = 0xfffffffe (a write: stop thread 0); poll; CTRL0 = 0x04801000 (T1 TXENABLE), DATAT = 0xfffffffe; poll; then RGX 0x1340 = 1, 0x12a8 = 8, SOFT_RESET 0x100 = 0x08000000, then Fender sleep control
preconditions: only after the firmware itself asked to stop. Writes only, no reads

slave-port accesses (in order): the same TXENABLE = 0xfffffffe write to T0 first; then (0x66906d0) more writes
preconditions: skipped when the GPU power is off ('Not stopping META firmware for inspection: GPU power is off')

path: failure dump: core-register read helpers 0x6694960 (read) and 0x6694b48 (TXUXXRXRQ/DT port at 0x0480fff8/fff0)
when: only from the failure dump (0x66919b8..0x6691d0c, the 'T0 PC ... waiting for BG kick' printout), after stop-for-inspection
slave-port accesses (in order): CTRL0 = address with the read bit, poll, read DATAX 0xa00
preconditions: thread 0 already stopped by the TXENABLE write
only when there is no GPC (Fender) object (accel +0x160 == 0). J81 has one, so it uses the GPC 'can park' check (vtable +0xa0) instead

slave-port accesses (in order): none: on J81 Apple's host never reads META through the slave port while the firmware runs normally
